name: learner_state
description: The learner's state from the app's six databases, summed up (read-db.py in the self-hosted mode): today's date; the reviews due (count and the first ids); the streak, derived from the session log (computed.streak: the days of the run going on, 0 once it ended; whether today is practised; the freezes held, 1 to start and 1 more every 7th practised day of a run, at most 2; the days they covered; whether a miss today would be covered; the last run), whether it is active and the days since the last session; the current and target level; each skill's mastery (0-5 stars) and accuracy; the top mistake patterns (pattern id, category, severity, frequency, the latest example); the last sessions (date, kind, minutes, accuracy, focus next); next_session_id for record_session; and languages: every language the learner has, the home one first (level, words, due). Read-only. Call it before planning, a progress report or record_session, not on every turn: the notebook already says who the learner is. language: another language's state (a code such as "it", or a name), e.g. for a visit; omit it for the home language.

language.description: Another language's state: a code ("it") or a name ("Italian"). Omit for the home language.
